thread:
olivia: Quick question — for the change that will make unpinned requests fall back to a cheaper model variant, what's the intended default behavior for clients that don't set a model or version header? Do we auto-switch them, or keep the current default until they explicitly pin? Need answer for SDK/docs planning. cc @kevin @maria

kevin: Short answer: we should NOT silently move existing clients to a different response shape. Plan is conservative: keep existing default model for requests without a pin for the deprecation window, and offer an opt-in header to select the new default early.

maria (Platform): Implementation plan I sketched: 1) Announce deprecation + timeline (30 days) 2) Add request header for explicit pinning/opt-in 3) Add response header indicating the variant served so clients can detect changes 4) Canary 5% traffic, then widen. Need to pick header names and confirm semantics.

devon: For SDKs, we'd prefer a stable header name we can surface easily. Suggest: Request: `Model-Pin: <model-id|variant>` or `Accept-Model: <id>` Response: `X-Model-Variant: <id>` Also: shape compatibility guarantee? We cannot change response schema without explicit major version bump.

kevin: +1 on header names. Concretely:
```
# request
Model-Pin: rwd-llama-3b-v1

# response
X-Model-Variant: rwd-llama-3b-v2
```
Semantics: server honors `Model-Pin` if valid; otherwise serves default. We'll promise backward-compatible field-level stability for minor/patch variants. Breaking schema changes require a documented major version and explicit client opt-in.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout at 1719004800 (canary-2024-05-03T10:00Z) — infra job queued (deploy id: canary-2024-05-03).

olivia: OK. So to be crystal clear for docs and SDKs:
- We announce deprecation of old default and provide 30-day window.
- During window, unpinned requests continue to see current default.
- We add `Model-Pin` request header + `X-Model-Variant` response header.
- Breaking schema changes will only happen behind an explicit major-version header/param.

maria (Platform): I'll own the migration doc & announcement. Draft will include examples, rollback steps, and a small compatibility test matrix. Will ping for reviews by EOD Friday.

devon: I'll add a test harness to the SDKs that asserts response fields for the common endpoints and runs against canary traffic. Also will add a convenience wrapper so SDK users can set `Model-Pin` easily.

kevin: Also request we add a console toggle (ops-only) to quickly revert the fallback behavior if we see problems in canary. Ops flag + metrics alerting. :thumbsup:

olivia: Great — thanks everyone. Action items: @maria write doc, @devon add tests/SDK surface, @kevin add flag + alerts. We'll reconvene async in this thread for PR links.
